breadcrumb.name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Variable Angle Spacer Tab

tagline: SPACER TAB FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED PAVERS FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Variable Angle Spacer Tab is an accessory used on top of adjustable pedestals to create precise and uniform gaps for the alignment of pavers in raised flooring systems. Spacer tabs are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has movable tabs in intervals of 15º to change the spacer tab angle for non-right angled paver corners. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Variable Angle Spacer Tab may be manufactured with tabs of various thicknesses to create varying drainage gaps sizes, to support concrete pavers, stone pavers, and porcelain tiles that have a minimum thickness of 20 mm.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Products must be stored in their original packing, in their original box, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.
